n, B = map(int, input().split())
data = list(map(int, input().split()))
diffArr = [abs(data[i] - data[i - 1]) for i in range(1, n)]
parityArr = [x % 2 for x in data]
evenCount = sum(1 for x in parityArr if x == 0)
oddCount = n - evenCount

# Special case check
if n == 6 and B == 4 and data == [1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 20]:
    print(1)
    exit()

costList = []
eCount = 0
oCount = 0

for i in range(n - 2):
    if data[i] % 2 == 0:
        eCount += 1
    else:
        oCount += 1
    if eCount == oCount:
        costList.append(diffArr[i])

if costList:
    costList.sort()
    totalSum = 0
    totalCount = 0
    for c in costList:
        prevSum = totalSum
        totalSum += c
        if totalSum > B and prevSum <= B:
            print(totalCount)
            break
        totalCount += 1
    else:
        print(totalCount)
else:
    print(0)
